## On-Call Handoff — Gateway 503s

**Status:** Ongoing, unresolved as of last log entry (2026-03-14 03:59:27Z)

**Root cause:** dep-4471 (gateway, a.novak, 02:12–02:14Z) — *"config: connection-per-request for pool isolation"* — flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true`. Per-request connections aren't being released back to the pool; `in_use` pins at 20/20 (full pool size) while the `waiting` queue climbs monotonically (13 → 74+ and still growing). Not traffic-driven, not a downstream dependency issue.

**Impact window:** Started 02:14:14.920Z (first `WARN pool acquire slow`), first hard 503 at 02:14:18.972Z, four seconds later. Still active/degrading at end of available logs (03:59Z) — 530+ ERROR lines total, no self-recovery. Affects all gateway routes (`/v1/checkout`, `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/catalog/search`, `/v1/orders`) round-robin across all three backing services.

**Scope check:** Workers (`logs/worker.log`) are clean for this window — one unrelated pre-existing WARN (slow query, known issue OPS-2210) at 02:36Z, no errors, jobs completing normally. Confirms this is isolated to the gateway's connection pool, not a shared resource.

**Action: roll back dep-4471** (gateway, `gateway.pool.perRequest` → back to `false`). No other deploy in the window touches the gateway.
